items.zh-CN: DPS 统计新增可从任意位置拖动的无边框悬浮窗，默认开启，可在 DPS 统计页关闭。
items.en: The DPS page now has a borderless overlay. It is enabled by default, can be dragged from anywhere, and can be turned off on the DPS page.

items.zh-CN: 悬浮窗首次定位在主程序所在屏幕的左上角。切回 DNF 时自动显示并保留游戏焦点，切出时隐藏；重启后恢复开关和已保存的位置。
items.en: The overlay starts in the upper-left corner of the app’s display. It appears without taking focus when you return to DNF, hides when you switch away, and remembers its position and enabled state across restarts.

items.zh-CN: 更新器同时检查 GitHub 和六个镜像，从返回当前发布清单最快的渠道下载安装包。下载失败或文件校验失败时自动切换渠道。
items.en: The updater checks GitHub and six mirrors in parallel, then downloads from the fastest channel serving the current manifest. It retries another channel if the download or integrity check fails.

items.zh-CN: 测试版本，用于验证客户端从 0.1.1 检测、下载并重启升级到 0.1.2 的流程。
items.en: Test release for verifying that version 0.1.1 detects and downloads the update, then restarts into version 0.1.2.

items.zh-CN: 关于页可查看当前版本和历史版本的更新内容。
items.en: The About page now lists changes for the installed version and earlier releases.

items.zh-CN: 更新清单和 GitHub 发布说明使用同一份中英文版本日志。
items.en: The updater and GitHub Releases now share the same bilingual release notes.

items.zh-CN: 按键连发支持逐键选择，可在 5 至 1000 ms 之间调整间隔。
items.en: Select individual keys and set a repeat interval from 5 to 1000 ms.

items.zh-CN: 侧边栏支持检查更新、查看下载进度和重启升级。
items.en: Check for updates, track the download, and restart to upgrade from the sidebar.
